description: This file contains client-side form scripts for the 'Gratuity Rule' DocType in an ERPNext module. It includes event handlers that manage user interactions with 'Gratuity Rule' and 'Gratuity Rule Slab' child table, such as adding slabs and validating year ranges.

methods.name: gratuity_rule_slabs_add
methods.description: Event handler to automatically set the 'from_year' of a new slab based on the previous slab's 'to_year', ensuring proper sequential order.

methods.name: to_year
methods.description: Validation method to ensure that the 'to_year' is not less than the 'from_year' and is not zero.
